notes.en: Static guide review draft: pinned source, exact license bytes, must-have gates, TCO and score arithmetic, evidence levels, conflict-of-interest handling and synthetic examples were checked. E1 is a supplied primary document read by the evaluator, not independently authenticated; the draft does not approve, purchase, pay, sign, terminate, contact a vendor or change a procurement record. No script, dependency, connector or execution is present. This unsigned draft is not a production review approval and makes no model-run, guest-execution, installation or App acceptance claim.
notes.zh-Hans: 静态指南审核草稿：已检查固定来源、完整许可字节、必须条件门槛、总成本与评分运算、证据等级、利益冲突处理及合成示例。E1 指评估人已阅读的所提供一手文件，并不表示已独立鉴证；草稿不批准、不采购、不付款、不签字、不终止、不联系供应商，也不修改采购记录。不附带脚本、依赖、外部连接或执行。此未签名草稿不是生产审核批准，也不声明模型运行、来宾执行、安装或 App 验收。
